description: This file defines the class HTTP_Session_Container_DB, a PEAR-based database session container implementation. It manages session data storage and retrieval in a database, and includes methods for connecting, reading, writing, destroying sessions, and database maintenance tasks.

classes.name: HTTP_Session_Container_DB
classes.description: A session container class implementing session data storage in a database, supporting connect, read, write, destroy, and garbage collection functionalities.

methods.name: HTTP_Session_Container_DB
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes options for database connection and table details.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a database connection using a DSN string or existing DB object.

methods.name: _setDefaults
methods.description: Sets default options for DSN, table name, and auto-optimization.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the database connection for session handling.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the database session handler (dummy implementation).

methods.name: read
methods.description: Fetches session data from the database using session ID.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Stores or updates session data in the database.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes session data from the database for a given session ID.

methods.name: replicate
methods.description: Copies session data to another table for replication purposes.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection by removing expired sessions and optionally optimizing the table.
